zh-CN.title: 那烂陀
zh-CN.subtitle: 求法叙事中的学习场所与后世学术记忆
zh-CN.shortSummary: 那烂陀让玄奘、义净等人的求法故事进入具体学习机构和跨区域知识网络，而不是停留在抽象的“印度”。
curatorialDescription: 现实地图只表达历史地点的地理参照；关于规模、课程、参与者和后世圣迹的说法必须按来源和年代拆开。
这也是研究层的入口：旅行者的记录、当地传统和现代考古叙述并不天然等价。
zh-CN.researchNote: 需要补充旅行记录、考古资料、机构史和不同语言传统之间的互证。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 隋唐求法与跨区域知识网络

en.title: Nalanda
en.subtitle: A site of learning and later scholarly memory in pilgrimage narratives
en.shortSummary: Nalanda places the pilgrimages of Xuanzang and Yijing within a concrete institution and transregional network rather than an abstract India.
curatorialDescription: The real map expresses a geographic referent; claims about scale, curriculum, participants and later sacred memory must be separated by source and period.
It is also a research-layer entry: traveller accounts, local traditions and modern archaeological narratives are not automatically equivalent.
en.researchNote: Travel records, archaeology, institutional history and cross-language comparison still need to be assembled.
en.timeLabel: Sui–Tang pilgrimage and transregional knowledge networks
